selection_rationale.reason: WebMCP Leverage requires 5 non-trivial tools; "execute: async (input) => { /* ... */ }" can abort mid-demo. withResilience/DegradedResult prevents blank-screen per "must be capable of being successfully installed and running consistently"

Submission requires deployed app; "Provide a working live URL that judges can access using ChatGPT's in-app browser" mandates hosting via Vercel/Cloudflare/any provider with origin-isolated tools policy self

No source 1 clause requires STT/TTS/vision/PDF; mandatory tools are typed JSON "search_inventory, filter_variants, calculate_shipping"; accepting risk of losing voice/multimodal bonus but not disqualification, avoids extra REPLICATE/ELEVENLABS keys

Submission field 4 mandates "must include a clear demo of your project functioning and with audio that covers what you built and how you used WebMCP" plus 4-prompt text; deckgen/script/demodrive/faqdef produce deck, timed script, Q&A and <3-min YouTube capture

Co-task is multi-step human+agent flow; "humans and agents can interact, collaborate, and create together" requires provider-agnostic message buffer to hold tool outputs across search→filter→hold→confirm without context-length error

Testing gate: "test your deployed app in ChatGPT's in-app browser or Google Chrome with WebMCP enabled" — doctor catches flag/origin-trial misconfig, mock replays tool-call envelopes offline, track prevents deck/submission staleness
Already consumed pre-assembly to propose manifest; no source 1 clause requires ASM/ADV CLI inside delivered app; accepting risk of losing in-app advisory but not Stage One, keeps bundle minimal

Golden path needs seeded fixtures for judges without Shopify tenant; "hold all low-stock variants under $12 shipping to zone 4" requires synthetic catalog/inventory/itinerary with synthetic:true watermark for offline rehearsal

Winning plan uses "Gemini 2.5 Flash via Gemini API parses multi-constraint intent" — LLM token burn risk; plus hosting "Vercel $30 in build credits (first 1000 builders)" cap; cost metering with CTX-02 counter prevents credit burn mid-demo

Rules require "Must be open source by including an open source license file" and "This license should be detectable and visible at the top"; prov/submit generate disclosure.md and enforce repo hygiene before public push
pgm is pre-assembly market research only, never part of the delivered app (NONGOAL-12) — Reddit-grounded winning_project_plan.md producer not judged as deployed application
